NeedDef.label: bloodlust
NeedDef.description: Tenebral implants hunger for killing. The more implants a pawn carries, the more often they must kill a humanlike to sate it. At zero, mood collapses and any mental break is a berserk rage, with a chance of defecting from the colony entirely.

li.label: bloodlust unsated
li.description: I need to kill. I need it now.
